# culipulse_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a notification channel by name, typically a Slack or Telegram channel you connected in the console, so you can route alerts to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "culipulse_channel" "team_slack" {
  name = "Slack · #ops-alerts"
  type = "slack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name, exactly as shown in the console, e.g. `Slack · #ops-alerts`.

### Optional

- `type` (String) `telegram`, `slack` or `webhook`. Needed only when two channels share a name.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel currently sends alerts.
- `id` (String) Channel id.
- `status` (String) `connected`, or `pending` while it is still being set up.
